info.name: ExpressHub API
info.description: All implemented ExpressHub endpoints. See docs/api.md for setup and a payment-free walkthrough. Examples are illustrative, not captured production data. Send requests individually: role changes, cancellation and deletion modify data. Payments are deferred; the payment folder is reference only.

request.description: Customer only. Requires one matching active pricing rule. Price/currency are calculated server-side. Optional dimensions must include all three; pickupScheduledAt must be a future ISO timestamp with timezone. Returns 201 data.shipment; decimal values are strings.

body.raw:
{
  "pickupContactName": "Example Sender",
  "pickupContactPhone": "+8801700000000",
  "pickupAddress": "123 Example Road, Dhaka",
  "deliveryContactName": "Example Recipient",
  "deliveryContactPhone": "+8801800000000",
  "deliveryAddress": "456 Example Road, Chattogram",
  "parcelWeightKg": 1.5,
  "packageDescription": "Books"
}

request.description: Assigned Courier or Admin for operational transitions; Customer can cancel own CREATED shipment. CREATED→PICKED_UP→IN_TRANSIT→OUT_FOR_DELIVERY→DELIVERED/FAILED; Admin FAILED→IN_TRANSIT/RETURNED. Expected status required. Pickup/dispatch/delivery require verified PAID and active courier; DELIVERED/FAILED/RETURNED require note. Returns data.shipment; conflicts 409.

CREATED→PICKED_UP→IN_TRANSIT→OUT_FOR_DELIVERY→DELIVERED/FAILED; Admin FAILED→IN_TRANSIT/RETURNED. Expected status required. Pickup/dispatch/delivery require verified PAID and active courier; DELIVERED/FAILED/RETURNED require note. Returns data.shipment; conflicts 409.
